_comment: Consumer adapter config for dispatch_launch.py --adapters. One entry per page role: the command that executes that role's page request. {request} is the page-request JSON path, {result} is where the consumer must write its page-result JSON, {work_dir} is the dispatch directory. A result is accepted only when it validates and echoes its request exactly (collect_launch_receipts rules). S49-08 assembly (this revision): six roles are wired (landing via landing_bridge.py, downsell_1 via downsell_wrapper.py, upsell_1 and upsell_2 via separate upsell_wrapper.py invocations, thank_you via translate_thank_you_result.py, all shipped in 49-signature-funnel/scripts/; product_selection via Skill 78's native emitter chain, re-pointed by the config retirement candidate); the /path/to/ entries keep this file's example convention and are replaced with real install paths at deployment. checkout is NOT wired and its placeholder entry is removed by design: per CR-S49-003 the order form is the native Convert and Flow form installed by Skill 06, never a dispatch adapter. downsell_1 is wired via downsell_wrapper.py to the Skill 81 consumer (Skill 81 landed on main in PR #2229 and the wrapper shipped in PR #2237; this sentence replaces the pre-landing text that said downsell_1 was not wired, a comment-only cure). A role with no adapter entry makes dispatch fail closed for that role rather than pretend. Per-role notes: landing also needs the bridge config named by --bridge-config (Skill 71 tree root plus the landing operator values; the bridge refuses to run when any operator value is missing) and consent statements reach the popup only via landing.consent_statements in that config. Upsell runs need the operator-staged work-dir inputs named in the command (launch.json, the per-instance copy document, the verified journey state, the enrichment sidecar) and the Skill 80 tree at the --produce path. product_selection takes one per-launch input, the approved launch record JSON named inside its command, which must be set for the launch before dispatching; the S44/S79 native mapping rows are no longer an adapter input, because the checkout_targets enrichment stays S49-side per CR-S49-002 and is not consumed by the native emitter chain. RETIREMENT DISCHARGED: Skill 78's native emitter fix landed in PR #2232 (batch train #2235), and the product_selection entry in this revision IS the native entrypoint (plan builder, then emit_page_result.py with --output and the request as echo source). selection_wrapper.py is retired as the seam mechanism and stays in the tree as built history and as the checkout_targets enrichment library; retirement is a routing fact, not a deletion (S49 retirement record, 2026-10-17). thank_you needs the Skill 82 thank-you result document and its companion run manifest in the work dir, and the dispatch run session id in --author-session.

command: python3 /path/to/78-signature-product-selection/scripts/build_selection_plan.py "<per-launch: approved launch record JSON>" > "{work_dir}/selection-plan.json" && python3 /path/to/78-signature-product-selection/scripts/emit_page_result.py "{work_dir}/selection-plan.json" --output "{result}" --author-session "s49-native-selection" --request "{request}"
